newsitem.title: USA: SEC bars former PaineWebber broker.
newsitem.headline: SEC bars former PaineWebber broker.

text.p: The U.S. Securities and Exchange said Monday it has barred a former PaineWebber Group Inc broker from the industry as a result of its insider trading charges filed against him in March.
The agency said, James D'Angelo, who worked as a stockbroker at PaineWebber's Andover, Mass., branch has agreed to the agency's latest action.

In March, the agency filed civil charges against D'Angelo, alleging he profited illegally from buying shares in Baybanks Inc in December,1995, while knowing about its impending acquisition by BankBoston Corp
The agency alleged that D'Angelo obtained the information through a tip from an attorney at Bingham, Dana & Gould, the Boston law firm representing BankBoston in the acquisition.
At the time of the complaint, D'Angelo settled the agency's charges and agreed to turn over $182,052, which included a penalty, his allegedly illegal gains and accrued interest.
